sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the name "Israel" specifically applies in the present era of struggle against the sitra achra, through the service of subjugation and transformation.

translations.translation: But still, one must understand,
what is the connection of "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you" specifically to one hundred blessings.
And this will be understood by prefacing what is said
(at the beginning of the verse)
"And now, Yisrael,"
specifically "and now,"
and the Tzemach Tzedek explains
that "and now" refers to the days of our years in this world,
and analogous to what is said at the conclusion of the previous portion,
"which I command you today to do them,"
and our sages said,
"Today to do them, and not tomorrow to do them."
For although the fulfillment of the mitzvos will also be in the days of Moshiach
(and on the contrary,
then specifically it will be "as the commandment of Your will"),
nevertheless,
the fulfillment of the mitzvos in the manner of "to do them,"
"doing" from the term meaning subjugation,
is specifically today,
for in the future it will be "and the spirit of impurity I will remove from the land,"
and consequently there will not be the service of subjugation.
And this is "And now, Yisrael,"
Yisrael is from the term "for you have striven with G-d,"
the domination over all the concealments and veils that derive from the name Elokim,
even to the concealments and veils of the animal soul and the evil inclination that entice a person to do the opposite, G-d forbid,
and the concept of Yisrael is that he dominates over the desires of the animal soul,
and even to "and you will prevail."
For at first they oppose and he dominates over them
(subjugation),
and afterwards "and you will prevail,"
meaning he vanquishes them
(transformation).
And this is "And now, Yisrael,"
that specifically now, when the existence of the sitra achra is present, he is called by the name Yisrael, from the term "for you have striven... and you will prevail,"
subjugation of the sitra achra and transformation of the sitra achra,
unlike in the future,
since "the spirit of impurity I will remove from the land,"
they will not be called by the name Yisrael
(striven)
but by the name Yeshurun,
or by the name
(other)
"which the mouth of Hashem will designate,"
as explained at length in the discourses of the Tzemach Tzedek.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ability of every Jew to dominate and overcome obstacles now comes from the level of the Mah (Yechidah) within him, which G-d asks to be revealed through his own service.

translations.translation: And it says "And now, Yisrael, what,"
that even now when the existence of the sitra achra is present,
and even in the time of exile and even in the footsteps of Moshiach
(the actual "now"),
it is within the power of every single Jew to dominate over all obstacles and hindrances and to vanquish them
("for you have striven... and you will prevail"),
it is from the aspect of the Mah within him,
the level of Yechidah.
For since the level of Yechidah has nothing opposing it,
therefore,
by arousing the Yechidah within him,
he has the power now to dominate over all opponents and vanquish them.
And this is what our sages said,
"Yisrael, even though he sinned, he is Yisrael"
[meaning not only Yaakov but also Yisrael,
the name of superiority],
for in every single Jew,
even when he has sinned,
the Yechidah is in perfection
[and as per the well-known ruling of the Rambam,
that every single Jew,
even when his inclination overpowers him to nullify a mitzvah
(even to the point that in order to fulfill the mitzvah he must be compelled by gentiles),
he wants to do all the mitzvos],
and therefore he is Yisrael,
meaning he has the power to be "for you have striven... and you will prevail."
And what they said,
"Who is a fool? One who loses what is given to him,"
and it is brought in Likkutei Torah
that it refers to the Mah in the soul
[for since
he is a fool,
he does not fight against the spirit of foolishness that enters him,
he loses, G-d forbid, the Mah within him],
the intention in this is,
that the Mah within him is in a state of great concealment.
And it is also understood from the language "Who is a fool? One who loses etc.,"
that it is analogous to a lost object,
that even after it is lost it is in perfection,
only that one must find it,
and by searching properly — he will surely find it.
And this is "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you,"
that Hashem your G-d asks and requests from you
(from every single Jew)
that the Mah within him be revealed.
That he should not, G-d forbid, lose the Mah that is given to him,
and even if he has lost it, G-d forbid — to search until he reveals the Mah through doing teshuvah.
And it emphasizes "from you,"
that the revelation of the Mah will be specifically through his own service.
For even when the arousal of teshuvah comes through the proclamations that are proclaimed from above,
or through various causes being brought about for this, as it is said,
"He devises plans so that the outcast shall not be cast away from Him,"
behold this is only the preparation for teshuvah,
but the teshuvah itself is done specifically through his own service,
"from you."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ultimate perfection of G-d's dwelling in the lower worlds is achieved specifically through our present service of subjugating and transforming the sitra achra.

translations.translation: And behold, that "What does Hashem your G-d ask of you" is specifically now
("today to do them"),
even though the perfection of the fulfillment of the mitzvos
("as the commandment of Your will")
will be specifically in the days of Moshiach,
it is,
in order that there be the service of subjugation of the sitra achra and transformation of the sitra achra
(meaning Yisrael),
for specifically through this is completed the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower worlds.
And even though the ultimate perfection will be specifically in the future
(as above),
behold the ultimate perfection of the future is that then there will be the revelation of the Essence of the Ein Sof in this physical world,
the lowest level beneath which there is no lower,
and this perfection is accomplished through our deeds and our service now,
specifically through the refinement and purification of the world as it is now.
And for this purpose the soul descended below,
that the primary intention in this is not for the sake of the ascent of the soul that is brought about by the descent,
but rather in order to refine and purify the body, the animal soul, and one's portion in the world,
for through this there will be the revelation in this physical world and the intention of a dwelling place in the lower worlds will be completed,
as all this is explained at length in Tanya.
